name: @bossnyumba/carbon-market
description: Carbon-market trading-desk layer: Verra (VCS) registry client, Climate Impact X (CIX) spot/forward feed adapters, on-chain tokenized-credit verification (Toucan/KlimaDAO/Moss), and a trading-desk orchestrator that plans purchases, books paper forwards, marks-to-market, and runs jurisdictional compliance (CORSIA, Article 6.2/6.4, domestic-only). Network boundary is injectable so production wires live HTTP / RPC adapters and tests stay offline.
